profile.headline: Embedded Systems Software Engineer at PACCAR
profile.summary:
Currently working at the PACCAR Technical Center as an Embedded Systems Software Engineer doing rapid controls prototyping for the industry leading Digital Display used in Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks around the world. 

Graduated Cum Laude with a B.S. in Computer Science and B.A.'s in Applied Physics and Mathematics from Whitworth University.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for rapid controls prototyping for the industry leading digital display used in many Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks around the world.  My role also handles defect resolution ensuring that the right team handles each issue.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Lead software developer in the Manufacturing Support Group in charge of test creation for assembly line validation of Kenworth and Peterbilt trucks at all plant locations. Main plant contact for any issues that arise during testing. Troubleshooting and maintenance of both tester software and hardware.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Research internship working towards building an SLA printer with a feature scale of 7 microns for the use of Lab on a Chip technology.

positions.title: Machine Shop Assistant
positions.description: Skills: Electronics · 3D Printing

positions.title: Campus Ministry Coordinator
positions.description: Residence hall leadership in charge of bringing the Christian faith to the residents. Setting up small groups, running worship nights, engaging in one-on-one conversation with those who need it.

volunteerExperiences.description: Creating in depth educational articles covering a wide range of topics related to the nerdier side of Lego.
Wrote articles for the popular LEGO blog The Brothers Brick. Covered topics from community members creations to set reviews to upcoming releases.

projects.title: UW Senior Capstone Industry Mentor
projects.description: PACCAR regularly sponsors Capstone Projects for the University of Washington. During UW's winter and spring quarters, I led a team of four students as they designed and built a robotic solution my team at PACCAR needed for cycle time reduction, efficiency, and repeatability.

projects.title: WhitSat Leader
projects.description: WhitSat is a student led CubeSat project in the Whitworth University Physics and Engineering Department working towards sending a custom build satellite into orbit. As a team leader I am a part of making executive decisions about critical designs and applications. My work is focused on the software and embedded systems aspects of the project, currently on building a semi-permanent ground station for communication with our CubeSat.
